title: SenMiydin?
short_description: Rediscover your city’s coincidences and finish the hellos you never said.
full_description:
SenMiydin? is a social app for rediscovering the small coincidences of your city. Share a hello that stayed unfinished on the beach, on the tram or on a journey, and turn it into a story with mutual approval.

Your city’s feed
Browse memories, thoughts, confessions, encounters and journey posts, and see the people you follow in a separate feed. Every post has a one-level comment conversation; like comments and replies and keep the posts you like in private collections.

Confirm an encounter together
Tag the person you met with @username. When they accept, the encounter is verified; a shared story needs a separate publishing approval.

Map Notes and My Letters
Leave a digital letter at an approximate point on the map for 7 days, public or anonymous, and let others answer. Manage active and archived letters in My Letters and share an expired one again. Get a small notification when a new letter is left near you.

Messages
The first message is a request. Once accepted, chat one-to-one with photos from the gallery or camera, emoji and approximate location messages. There is no live location sharing.

Privacy and safety
Your exact location is never shown to other users, only an approximate distance or area. Places I Passed is optional and off by default. SenMiydin? is for ages 16 and over: accounts aged 16–17 only meet their own age group and accounts aged 18 and over only meet adults. Blocking, reporting and account deletion are in the app.

Ads
Small native ads labelled “Ad” may appear in the feed. Your location is never used for ad targeting, and accounts aged 16–17 never see personalized ads.

You can use the app without location permission by choosing your city by hand. SenMiydin? does not promise to find a specific person and offers no live tracking of people or vehicles.
